_comment: Role starter kits. Each kit is its own plugin in the marketplace. 'core' skills go into every kit. The 'all' kit (zevero-sales) contains every skill. Skill names, not paths. scripts/build.py generates the marketplace from this file.

kits.name: zevero-sales-sdr
kits.description: For SDRs and BDRs: find and research the right accounts, enrich contacts, write outbound that gets replies, and hand off a well-prepared first meeting.

kits.name: zevero-sales-ae
kits.description: For account executives, discovery to signature: prep and qualify (MEDDPICC), demo, handle objections, build the value case and proposal, negotiate and close.

kits.name: zevero-sales-am
kits.description: For account managers and customer success: account context and plans, health checks and QBRs, renewals, churn saves, expansion and references.

kits.name: zevero-sales-leader
kits.description: For sales leaders and RevOps: pipeline and forecast reviews, deal inspection, call coaching, win/loss, coverage maths, CRM hygiene and rep ramp.

all.name: zevero-sales
all.description: Every Zevero sales skill: our own playbooks plus vetted public skills for prospecting, discovery, deal reviews, proposals, negotiation and account management. Most people should install their role kit instead.
